parsed.answer: The evidence reports the opposite direction: ectopic overexpression of the H3K9 demethylase KDM4E in bovine SCNT embryos increases cloning efficiency and improves blastocyst formation. KDM4D and KDM4E are identified as the H3K9me3/2 demethylases whose deficiency underlies the persistent H3K9me3 barrier, so their expression (i.e., H3K9me3 removal) rescues rather than reduces reprogramming. The claim that such expression decreases SCNT reprogramming efficiency is therefore contradicted by the retrieved abstract.
